_comment: M3.3 S3 — non-secret resource identity registry: allow-list / deny-list information ONLY, never runtime authority (the runtime configuration is authoritative). developmentSupabaseProjects: the projects development servers and write-capable test harnesses may target, and that production/maintenance refuse. Production lists hold only founder-confirmed resources (M3.4d: productionEmailDomains = tenotrainer.com, the founder-verified production sending domain in Resend (us-east-1); M3.4e: productionSupabaseProjects = wfaalpfobpmojohetjlr, the founder-provisioned production project tenotrainer-production); never add a guessed identity. developmentEmailDomains: the ONLY sender domains development Resend delivery may use (M3.3 S3c) — dev-mail.tenotrainer.test is RFC 6761 reserved and can never deliver; enabling real development email requires registering a real development sending domain here through a reviewed change.
